Container.Name: astris
Container.Overview: Private, self-hosted household finance hub. Import bank statements, share accounts within households, everything stays on your server. Needs a PostgreSQL container.

Config.Name: Postgres host
Config.Description: IP or container name of your PostgreSQL server

Config.Name: Postgres admin URL (first run)
Config.Description: postgresql://postgres:PASSWORD@HOST:5432/postgres. Used only at startup to create the app's roles and database. Can be removed after the first successful start.

Config.Name: App DB password
Config.Description: Password for the ft_app role (long random string)

Config.Name: Owner DB password
Config.Description: Password for the ft_owner role (long random string)

Config.Name: Allow new sign-ups
Config.Description: Turn off once everyone in your home has an account
